india.one_line: Eternal unveils encrypted AI platform Dark while Karta AI secures seed funding for banking automation.

themes.title: Eternal launches encrypted AI platform
themes.text: Eternal announced Dark, a privacy‑focused AI assistant with end‑to‑end encryption and an encrypted memory layer, slated for global rollout in 2026.

stories.headline: Eternal unveils Dark, a privacy‑focused AI assistant, aims for global launch in 2026
Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal announces privacy‑focused AI platform Dark.ai

themes.title: Karta AI raises seed for banking calls
themes.text: Fintech AI startup Karta AI raised $3 million to expand its platform that automates complex inbound banking queries across 25 languages, cutting costs by about half.

stories.headline: Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls
